title: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sents.t: Amar Kate posted the following video and writes, "We should have listened to the dog and the knocking downstairs."
sents.zh: Amar Kate 发布了下面这段视频，并写道：“我们早该听狗狗的，也该在意楼下的敲门声。”

sents.t: This is what they caught on camera.
sents.zh: 这就是他们拍到的画面。

sents.t: All right, come on. We're gonna have to go and check.
sents.zh: 好了，走吧。我们得下去看看。

sents.t: Leave him up here. Come on.
Forget the keys. It's probably best to just leave.
sents.zh: 别管钥匙了，最好直接离开。

sents.t: And of course, don't forget the dog.
